description:
What the control-room window is allowed to reach.

Deliberately tiny. Every privileged action -- spawning `desentryd`, writing node.json, reading the OS keychain, choosing a folder, showing a notification -- is a named command in src/commands.rs, invoked from the web view and executed in Rust. Custom commands are not gated by capabilities, so what is listed here is only the handful of built-in surfaces the window genuinely touches.

The dialog, notification, os and autostart plugins are registered on the Rust side and driven from Rust; the web view never calls them directly, so they are not granted here. If a future change calls one from TypeScript, the grant has to be added deliberately rather than already being present.
